title: Waypoint store 256-entry static footprint vs STM32WL RAM budget (needs Mark's call)
description: Deployment constraint surfaced by o8dp review (spec 18.3.2 R-12-029 chose global 256): the waypoint store is now two static images (s_store + mutex-guarded s_staged staging buffer) at ~76KB each (~152KB total) in lichen/subsys/lichen/coap/coap_waypoints.c, plus the store image passed to the config load/save callbacks. This exceeds the STM32WL 64KB RAM baseline cited in AGENTS.md (fits nRF52840-class 256KB parts and native_sim). Options for constrained boards: config-limited runtime max (e.g. Kconfig LICHEN_WAYPOINT_MAX smaller per board), heap-allocated staging, or a no-copy persistence path. Decide the RAM strategy before flashing coap-waypoints firmware to STM32WL-class devices.
